scheme_name: HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth

text_blocks.text: HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth (Key fund facts): NAV (02 Jul '26): ₹158.75. Expense ratio: 0.77%. Minimum SIP investment: ₹100. Fund size (AUM): ₹38,809.48 Cr. Riskometer Category: Very High Risk.
HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth (Exit load): Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year
HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth (Benchmark): Fund benchmark: BSE 250 SmallCap Total Return Index
HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth (Investment objective): The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation /income by investing predominantly in Small-Cap companies.

HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth (Stamp duty and tax): Stamp duty and tax implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.

HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Growth (Fund management): Fund Manager: Dhruv Muchhal. Education: Mr. Dhruv has done B.Com, CA and CFA. Experience: Prior to joining HDFC MF,he has worked with Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd., Goldman Sachs, CRISIL Global Research & Analytics and Deloitte Haskins & Sells
